objective: Test whether validated 1H/H4 side-specific MAE improves the existing 12Min/H12 Ridge opportunity policy when used as continuous exposure/risk budgeting rather than the rejected binary q80 veto.
timestamp_contract: Use the evidenced America/New_York right-close -> UTC bar-start correction. A 1H score is usable only after the full hour closes.

opportunity_policy.signal_rule: Preserve the existing prior-only four-fold OOF q50 absolute expected-move magnitude gate and Ridge direction exactly.

risk_model.model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=quantile, quantile=0.80, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=180, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=42)
risk_model.prerequisite: The exact timestamp-corrected H4 risk-state contract must retain its frozen advancement result before economic evaluation.

consumer.name: inverse_mae_exposure_neutral_budget
consumer.rule: For each Ridge signal, use the latest fully completed-hour predicted MAE for that signal side. On prior training Ridge-signal rows only, compute the side-specific median predicted MAE. Raw weight = side_training_median_predicted_mae / current_predicted_mae. Clip raw weight to [0.50, 1.50]. Compute the mean clipped raw weight across all prior training Ridge-signal rows and divide each future raw weight by that training-only mean; clip the final future weight again to [0.50, 1.50]. Direction and signal presence are unchanged.
consumer.cost_accounting: Economic points and round-trip point cost are both multiplied by fractional exposure weight. This is a research notional-equivalent simulation, not an executable contract-size rule.
forbidden: change Ridge direction or magnitude gate
use realized future MAE to size a trade

chronology.discovery: Quarterly expanding walk-forward from 2023Q3 through 2025Q4. Opportunity and risk models use separate horizon purges and only prior data.
chronology.phase_rule: Every absolute-UTC non-overlap H12 phase is reported; none selected post-hoc.
chronology.forward: Only a full discovery pass earns an unchanged corrected-2026 confirmation.

required_metrics: unit Ridge baseline and risk-budget weekly phase-net statistics

discovery_advance_rule: At both 1pt and 2pt require >=80 paired weeks; risk-budget paired median delta >=0 and mean delta >0; paired win fraction >0.50; positive-week fraction no worse than unit Ridge; p10 and bottom-decile mean no worse; max drawdown improves by at least 10%; OOS mean exposure weight must remain in [0.90, 1.10]. All checks must pass. If not, reject this risk-budget formula rather than changing caps or normalization post-hoc.
interpretation: A pass would support 1H as a continuous capital/risk context for a 12Min opportunity engine, not as a direction source. A fail rejects this formula only, not the independently validated risk predictor or the 12Min Ridge opportunity model.
nq_boundary: NQ remains reserved for later independent/pre-MNQ validation of an unchanged composite after MNQ discovery and corrected-2026 confirmation.
